tests.prompt: Design a flagship homepage for a boutique horology workshop restoring vintage mechanical watches.
acceptance_criteria: Produces tactile, heritage-grounded identity distinct from SaaS layouts.

tests.prompt: Design a developer observability console for inspecting distributed traces and p99 latency.
acceptance_criteria: Prioritizes compact density, keyboard efficiency, and scannable data over marketing hero styling.

tests.prompt: Set up fluid typography and tabular numeric alignment for a multi-currency treasury dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Uses tabular-nums on numeric columns and CSS clamp() without JS resize listeners.

tests.prompt: Improve the reading ergonomics of a long-form technical essays site where lines span 130 characters.
acceptance_criteria: Constrains body measure to ~55-75ch with balanced line-height and clean mobile heading scale.

tests.prompt: Create a semantic light and dark color token system for a clinical patient portal.
acceptance_criteria: Meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast in both modes without blind color inversion.

tests.prompt: Update the primary brand accent token from #2563eb to #0d9488 while preserving button text contrast.
acceptance_criteria: Updates semantic token cleanly and verifies contrast on accent surfaces.

tests.prompt: Compose a product launch page with varied section rhythm instead of repeating 3-column card grids.
acceptance_criteria: Varies scale, alignment, and density across sections; earns containers instead of wrapping everything in cards.

tests.prompt: Redesign a 3-step SaaS onboarding flow that hides skip options and shows a generic 'Something went wrong' error.
acceptance_criteria: Provides clear step progress, non-manipulative skip/back paths, and actionable error recovery.

tests.prompt: Add a notification preferences panel to an app with established CSS custom properties and Button/Switch components.
acceptance_criteria: Reuses existing tokens and primitives; zero redesign of unrelated views.

tests.prompt: Critique a landing page featuring a generic purple gradient hero, 3 identical glassmorphic cards, 'Trusted by 10,000+ teams' placeholder stats, and '→' on every link.
acceptance_criteria: Identifies root visual/copy weaknesses and proposes targeted improvements without modifying files.

tests.prompt: Build a dark-mode audio synthesizer plugin page with subtle radial glow gradients as requested in our brand brief.
acceptance_criteria: Honors explicit user gradient request while avoiding generic SaaS clichés.

tests.prompt: Adapt a 7-column enterprise permissions matrix table for 375px mobile viewports without dropping critical toggle actions.
acceptance_criteria: Re-composes table cleanly for mobile while preserving all permissions and >=44px touch targets.

tests.prompt: Build an editorial photography portfolio when no image-generation tool or local photos exist yet.
acceptance_criteria: Uses intentional aspect-ratio frames/placeholders without referencing nonexistent image files or claiming images were generated.

tests.prompt: Fix a 4px misalignment on the footer copyright text.
acceptance_criteria: Stays in QUICK mode and loads zero creative-direction or industry references.
